title: Meta Q3 2026: Revenue $64.6B beats (+26%), but $9.89B teen settlement charge; AI capex $34.9B free cash flow turns negative
summary: Meta's Q3 2026 revenue rose 26% to $64.6B, beating ~$63.3B consensus. GAAP diluted EPS was $3.83, reduced by a $9.89B settlement with 52 US state AGs over teen mental health. Excluding the charge, adj. EPS ~$7.40. AI-related capex rose 80% Y/Y to $34.9B in Q3, pushing free cash flow to -$2.12B. Q4 revenue guidance: $73–76B. Full-year 2026 capex guidance raised to $135–145B. Ad revenue grew 26%.
why: 延续报道：10月21日发布，Meta AI资本支出ROI争论正在市场持续发酵，自由现金流转负引发整个科技板块对AI投入的重新审视（Nasdaq全周大跌）。Q4指引强劲但$135-145B全年AI资本支出预期令投资者警惕；对腾讯、阿里云、谷歌云等AI竞争格局有参照价值，同时本轮广告强势对Meta的 sell put 策略较有利。

title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule (effective Jan 18 2027); Circle (CRCL) surges ~6%
summary: The OCC issued its final GENIUS Act implementing rule on Oct 21, to take effect Jan 18, 2027. The rule covers reserves, redemption, risk management, custody and capital for payment stablecoin issuers under OCC jurisdiction. The final rule offers more flexibility on stablecoin rewards vs. the initial proposal. USDC issuer Circle's stock (CRCL) rose approximately 6% on the news. USDC circulation stands at ~$73.3B. The Fed and FDIC still need to finalize their own rules before the full GENIUS Act is operational.
why: 延续报道：10月21日发布，稳定币监管规则仍在行业持续解读和发酵中——Fed/FDIC尚未发布配套规则，业界正在消化GENIUS Act的具体合规路径。对Circle（CRCL）直接利好，明确了2027年合规框架；稳定币监管确定性助力机构入场，可能影响USDC对Tether等的竞争格局。
